name: Worcester Center for Crafts Youth Summer Program
description_short: A full-day craft and art day camp in Worcester, MA for ages 7–13, running 9:00am–3:00pm. Each week you pick one class from separate tracks for ages 7–9 and 10–13, covering things like stained glass, metalsmithing, fiber arts and animation.

warnings: Old season: the page only covers summer 2026 (June 29 – August 21, 2026), which is over as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.
Typo in the Week 6 summary line ('August 3 – 7August 14'). The class listings give Week 6 as August 3–7, and I used those dates.
Weeks are not all the same length. Week 1 is 4 days (June 29–July 2), Week 3 is 3 days (July 13–15), and the rest are 5 days. Prices change to match.

Each week offers several different classes at different prices ($252–$450 per week, and $780 for the two-week movie class). price_per_week is set to $420, the most common 5-day price, but many 5-day classes cost $450.
The $20 discount code SUMMER26 expired on 3/15/26.
